caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional, architectural structure resembling an altar or shrine with decorative elements. It is composed of two rounded columns, each adorned with vertical stripes and spots in green, red, yellow, and blue, supporting an arched top. The arch is patterned with similar colors and features a central circular relief above the archway. Below the arch and framed by the columns is a niche containing a small sculpted figure of a person with black hair, light skin, red lips, and dressed in a white garment, kneeling with clasped hands on a decorated rectangular pedestal that includes patterns in red and green. The base of the structure is broad, stepped, and mostly green with darker patches and white highlights. The background is plain and uncolored, and faint signatures or inscriptions are visible at the bottom left corner. The drawing is made with watercolors and pencil, giving the colors a soft, blended effect.
title: Religious Wood Carving
